annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei: Tipifica na lei penal a alteração de fotos, vídeos e som com o uso de sistema de Inteligência Artificial para praticar violência contra a mulher
annotation.title_en: Bill: Criminalizes the alteration of photos, videos and sound using Artificial Intelligence systems to commit violence against women
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dep. Saullo Vianna (União Brasil/AM), Câmara dos Deputados
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill presented to the Chamber of Deputies in February 2024 amending the Penal Code to criminalise altering photos, videos or sound with AI to humiliate, harass or threaten women in domestic or family settings, with two to four years' imprisonment and a fine.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Art. 216-C to the Penal Code criminalising AI-based manipulation of images, video or audio against women.
Penalty: reclusão of two to four years plus a fine.
Applies to the domestic or family sphere, with intent to cause humiliation, harassment, threat or violence.
Justified by growing AI use for gender-based violence and deepfakes.
